card.card: In a basic formulation, PID control combines three responses to error: proportional action responds to present error, integral action accumulates it, and derivative action responds to its rate of change. card.card: A quotient group replaces a group’s individual elements with cosets of a normal subgroup. Multiplying those cosets gives a new group whose elements each represent an entire collection of original elements.
